segments.text: MErcifull father geue vs grace, that we neuer preſume to ſinne through the example of anye creature, but if it ſhall chaunce vs at any tyme to offende thy dyuine maieſtie: that then we maye truly repent, and lament the ſame, after the example of Mary Magdalene, and by lyuelye faythe obtayne remiſſion of all oure ſinnes: throughe the onely merites of thy ſonne oure ſauiour Chriſt.
